Keeping Commerce Weird
Keeping Commerce Weird is a biweekly podcast hosted by Commerce CEO Travis Hess that explores the quirks, creativity, and human side of modern commerce. Each episode mixes bold opinions and sharp insights, candid conversations with those who know the industry best, and customer stories with a spotlight on the unexpected niches and cultural shifts shaping how we buy and sell.
